title: usePaginationState Hook
description:
Implement a `usePaginationState` hook that returns `{ page, totalPages, next, prev, isFirst, isLast }`. Page starts at `1`. `next()` and `prev()` are clamped — they do nothing when already at the boundary.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { page, totalPages, next, prev, isFirst, isLast } = usePaginationState({ total: 50, pageSize: 10 });
```
ai_context: Common mistake: computing totalPages with Math.floor instead of Math.ceil — this underestimates pages when items don't divide evenly, leaving the last partial page unreachable.
